title: Reducing the Impact of Collisions Assessment

questions.question: Which device inflates to cushion a passenger?
questions.explanation: An airbag cushions the body during a crash.

questions.question: Crumple zones make crashes safer mainly by
questions.explanation: They deform to extend the collision and absorb energy.
options: extending stopping time and absorbing energy

questions.question: Seatbelts and airbags help reduce peak force on the body.
questions.explanation: They increase stopping time and manage force.

questions.question: Crumple zones are designed to keep every part of a car perfectly rigid.
questions.explanation: Crumple zones are designed to deform.

questions.question: A vehicle part designed to fold during a crash is a ________ zone.
questions.explanation: Crumple zones deform to absorb energy.

questions.question: How does a helmet reduce injury during impact?
questions.correctAnswer: A good answer mentions foam compression increasing stopping time and spreading force.
questions.explanation: The foam compresses, increasing stopping time and reducing peak force on the head.

questions.question: Which statement best matches this lesson?
questions.explanation: The first option states a central idea from the lesson.
options: Safety devices reduce peak force by increasing the time over which momentum changes.
The topic is unrelated to force, motion, or electricity.
The safest answer is always to ignore evidence.
